vendor_findings.daily_contract_volume: Total Volume and Open Interest unchecked selects the individual contract. Daily and intraday volumes are not documented as identical universes.
vendor_findings.intraday_trade_filter: Only qualifying last-price transactions; excludes blocks and other types included in daily volume. Not a proof of missing-minute semantics.
vendor_findings.timezone: Futures CSV intraday labels are Chicago central civil time. This does not independently certify interval endpoints.
